reviews.author: Saraswathi
reviews.title: Amazing product
reviews.body: The product is amazing. Installation experience was also good. There was low water pressure at my home. But Atomberg provides a free motor to increase the water pressure. There was an adaptor required for the pipe connection which was about 200 rupees. Ensure that the product size fits correctly in the area of installation as this is slightly bigger compared to other purifiers. Prefilter is also present in the box. You can see the input/output TDS levels in the Atomberg home app.

reviews.author: Gautam
reviews.title: Better than competition
reviews.body: Smooth and fast installation. Purifier looks cool and futuristic. Water is very tasty.

reviews.author: Justin
reviews.title: Best one - out there
reviews.body: Amazing product and great installation experience. Clear explanation provided. I recommend this over all other non adaptive water purifiers. Saves water plus saves money.

reviews.author: Jay
reviews.title: Good one
reviews.body: Been using this purifier for a couple of weeks now and overall experience is good. Water tastes clean and the purifier looks quite premium in the kitchen. Installation was also smooth. So far, no issues with the product. The adaptive mode was the main reason I went for this one. Water quality in my area keeps changing, so I didn't want RO running unnecessarily all the time. The purifier adjusts according to the incoming water, which is quite convenient. Good product overall. Build quality is genuinely good. It feels sturdy and the finishing is also nice. reviews.author: Riju
reviews.title: Good experience overall
reviews.body: Overall experience was seamless. Installation was done the very next day. The technician (Sharaf) was knowledgeable and work was done quickly and neatly. He tested the water quality and pressure. Fixed a booster pump at no additional cost. Then he explained the functions and initial process clearly. Connected the device via app and explained it as well. The product seems to be pretty good except for the water dispenser handle that seems very flimsy on and otherwise well built product. Till now all seems good. I've had good experience with other Atomberg products so expecting the same here too.
